summary.name: Katalon True
summary.one_liner: Katalon True is an AI testing platform for QA teams that manages and runs manual, automated, and AI-generated tests across web, mobile, API, and desktop apps.
use_cases: Generating test cases from Jira tickets or requirements
Running Playwright tests on cloud browsers and devices
Tracking test results and release quality across manual and automated runs
Automating web, mobile, API, and desktop tests with mixed-skill teams
Finding coverage gaps from real user sessions in production
summary.what_it_does: Katalon True bundles four products: Katalon Studio for authoring web, mobile, API, and desktop tests with no-code, low-code, or full-code options; TestOps for test management, run tracking, and release evidence; TestCloud for parallel execution on real browsers and iOS/Android devices; and TrueTest, which observes production user journeys and generates tests for coverage gaps. Katalon AI generates test cases from requirements or tickets, self-heals locators, and explains failures. TestOps can ingest Playwright results from a repository, and TestCloud can run Playwright specs in parallel. An MCP integration lets coding agents such as Copilot, Cursor, Claude, and Codex drive Katalon directly.
notable: Katalon Studio is built on Selenium and Appium, and TestOps ingests Playwright results alongside Katalon and manual runs
Katalon MCP lets coding agents like Copilot, Cursor, Claude, and Codex run Katalon suites
TrueTest analyzes real production user sessions to generate tests for coverage gaps
Self-healing locators and AI-generated test cases reviewed by the tester before approval
caveats: Plans differ by product and execution needs; TestCloud sessions come as an allotment with paid add-ons available
Free start is offered with no credit card, but the page does not list specific plan prices; the pricing page holds current structure
The page says Katalon is listed on awesome-mac as freeware, but that listing refers to Katalon Studio and the page itself does not state a license
